name: BTL
summary: Suzhou Betely Polymer Materials Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells electronic chemical materials. It provides conductive silver paste, LED encapsulates, silicon rubber, UV curing materials, coatings and inks, semiconductor materials, and others, that can be applied in various fields, including 3C electronics, touch screen, EMI, NFC, FRID, LSR, encapsulate glue, protective film, release film, solar energy, and semiconductor. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Changshu, China.
